detection_basis: Frozen Feddes implementation and already-bound RA02 inputs only; no RA02 scientific root-response output was inspected or used.

defect.claimed_semantic: Se0 = h3(Tp) effective-saturation equivalent + 0.001 for every history.
defect.feddes_rule: For ADCRL=0.1 < Tp=0.3 <= ADCRH=0.5, critical h3 is interpolated linearly in pressure-head space between h3H and h3L; it is not h3L.
defect.implication: V02 and V04 are analytically already drought-stressed at the initial committed state, so the preregistered requirement that observation 1 be unstressed cannot be satisfied by design.

repair_boundary.reason: RA02 execution has already begun and its preregistration explicitly forbids adjusting initial Se after response. A corrected panel must be a separately preregistered work unit whose values are derived only from the frozen Feddes equation.
